cache_assumptions: Expected: zero-cache, based on 433,152 input and 73,728 billed output tokens per candidate. Conservative bound applies 5-minute cache-write input rate to all OpenAI and Anthropic input; Gemini uses standard input pricing. Add one retry per candidate provider at the frozen per-request maximum, then 20% contingency over the aggregate. Cache discounts are not assumed guaranteed.
reasoning_tokens: Billed provider reasoning/thought tokens count against output cap and estimate; no separate uncapped reasoning allowance.
notes: Prices and token counts are planning estimates, not provider billing guarantees.
Expected and worst-case values cover paid candidates only; Codex subscription baseline quota remains unknown.
The proposed USD threshold is not execution authorization or a provider-side billing cap.
No retry is allowed for refusal or max-token partial responses.
